crossRefs.note: I came today to the spring, and said, ‘Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—
Then the king said to me, “What is your request?” So I prayed to the God of heaven.
To you, Yahweh, I lift up my soul.
In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit…
Yahweh of Armies will defend them; and they will destroy and overcome with sling stones; and they will drink, and roar…
Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”
bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

people.name: Hannah
people.line: The mother of the prophet Samuel.

translations.web: Now Hannah spoke in her heart. Only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard. Therefore Eli thought she was drunk.
translations.bsb: Hannah was praying in her heart, and though her lips were moving, her voice could not be heard. So Eli thought she was drunk
translations.kjv: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.
translations.asv: Now Hannah, she spake in her heart; only her lips moved, but her voice was not heard: therefore Eli thought she had been drunken.
